name: Fortem
tagline: Control plane for teams running 10+ AWS ECS Fargate environments
description: Control plane for teams running 10+ AWS ECS Fargate environments. - **Schedule** non-prod environments to stop outside business hours — cut dev/staging compute 60–70% - **Clone** any environment to another region in ~30 seconds - **Monitor** per-environment cost in real time - **Fix** task failures with AI that reads CloudWatch and proposes the fix Runs in your own AWS account. No Terraform changes.
